result.rationale: Mission Clean Energy LLC is an active U.S. utility-scale solar and battery-storage development platform. Current company sources continue to identify an affiliate of Wafra-managed funds as Mission's principal investor following Wafra's announced acquisition of a controlling interest in 2022. No platform exit or signed pending platform transfer was identified through the cutoff.

identityResolution.sellerFounders: Max Bakker is identified as co-founder/CEO. No third-party seller was publicly disclosed. Founder retained ownership is not publicly confirmed.
identityResolution.classification: Manager-level renewable-development platform; keep development SPVs beneath Mission.

ownershipResolution.summary: Wafra retains evidenced control. Ørsted separately provided minority strategic capital. Exact Wafra fund, vehicle, percentages and founder/API current ownership remain undisclosed.

operatingResolution.classification: Utility-scale solar and BESS developer and development-stage asset owner.
operatingResolution.ownedVsPipeline: Mission-owned Midwest BESS projects totaling about 1 GW are development assets. Broader 10-11+ GW figures represent development pipeline/queue rather than operating ownership.
operatingResolution.scale: Pipeline expanded from about 3 GW in 2022 to more than 11 GW under development by 2025.
operatingResolution.footprint: Headquartered in San Francisco with projects across multiple U.S. states.
operatingResolution.platformBoundary: Keep Mission Clean Energy Devco LLC and project SPVs beneath the Mission platform unless separately manager-owned.

completedProjectTransfers: Bluebird Solar project sold to rPlus in 2025; project-level disposition only.
acquisitionExitCheck.finding: No Wafra platform exit, ownership transfer or signed pending platform transaction identified through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Wafra announced acquisition of a controlling interest; API invested alongside.
Mission and Ørsted announced four Mission-owned Midwest BESS projects totaling about 1 GW.
Ørsted completed and announced strategic minority investment.
Bluebird Solar project sold to rPlus; not a platform exit.

evidence.label: Mission/Ørsted BESS partnership
evidence.purpose: Mission-owned development assets and project options.

evidence.label: Ørsted strategic investment
evidence.purpose: Minority strategic capital and development scale.

beforeAfterChanges.after: Create one active Mission Clean Energy platform under Wafra, record separately evidenced Ørsted minority capital, consolidate development SPVs beneath Mission, and treat exact Wafra vehicle, percentages and founder/API retention as not publicly disclosed.

excludedOrDuplicateCandidates.candidate: Mission Clean Energy Devco LLC and project SPVs

excludedOrDuplicateCandidates.reason: Project sold; not a separate manager-held platform.
Project rights are not platform ownership transfers.

unresolvedQuestions: Exact Wafra fund and legal investment vehicle.
Current founder and API ownership, if any.
result.recommendedListAction: PROPOSED_NEW: add Mission Clean Energy LLC as a Wafra-controlled renewable-development platform, preserve all projects/SPVs beneath Mission, distinguish Ørsted as separately evidenced minority capital, and leave undisclosed ownership fields as NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
